hypothesis: ETH-as-primary-book is untried (ETH only tried as BTC filter, v46 DEAD dilutive). All BTC-model lines are dead/audited with rank ~0 everywhere (best fresh rank +0.0727 v41 / +0.066 v38 / +0.074 v29-residual). Scout whether an ETH 6h-clock book carries cheap HGB-predictable direction edge before any full training.
scope: SCOUT ONLY: data check + small decision-clock/label build mirroring BTC v4 + cheap CPU HGB walk-forward diagnostics. NO full training, NO cloud submit, NO portfolio/backtest, NO live orders.

data_inventory.eth_5m: MISSING locally (only BTCUSDT 5m exists). Crawl ETHUSDT 5m 2022-01-01 -> 2026-03-23 public klines (same pagination pattern as scripts/opencode_crawl_eth.py) into NEW data/raw/opencode_eth_5m_*/ for coverage/gap record. Baseline diagnostics do NOT need 5m (6h closes suffice); 5m is coverage inventory for any future full-training decision only.

decision_clock.grid: ETH 6h bars, 00/06/12/18 UTC (same grid as BTC v4 stride-72 6h decisions)
decision_clock.signal_time: close_time of 6h bar t (decision strictly after candle t closes; labels use bars strictly after t, so no fill before t+1 by construction)
decision_clock.label_end: close_time of bar t+28 (max horizon 7d, mirrors BTC v4 holding_days [3,7])
decision_clock.cutoff: 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z (label_end must be < cutoff; mirrors BTC development cutoff)

labels.three_class: up if fwd > +0.02, down if fwd < -0.02, else flat (fixed +/-2% thresholds, pre-specified from ETH 7d marginal scale sigma~9%: P(up)~39%/P(down)~38%/P(flat)~24%, balanced by construction of the marginal, NOT tuned on any model outcome)

features_past_only: lr1, lr2, lr4, lr8, lr16, lr28 (log close[t]/close[t-k], bars <= t only)
rsi14 on closes up to t (Wilder, causal)
realized vol: std of 6h log-returns over last 12 and 28 bars
funding_last = last fundingRate with funding_time <= signal_time (causal join), funding_chg8h, funding_mask

walk_forward.train_mask: label_end < fit_at - 8d AND signal_time >= fit_at - 730d (embargo 8d >= 7d max horizon)
walk_forward.insufficient_rule: skip fold with note (no threshold/fold tuning on outcomes)
walk_forward.oos: all decisions with signal_time in month M, predicted by fit_at(M) model only; signal_time >= fit_at enforced by assert

model.note: Single fixed seed (CPU budget, HGB near-deterministic); mirrors B1 single-seed discipline.

metrics_oos_pooled_diagnostic_only.rank_primary: Spearman(P(up), realized fwd7) pooled over all OOS decisions
metrics_oos_pooled_diagnostic_only.topdecile_hit_primary: P(fwd7 > 0 | top-decile by P(up)) (top 10%, k = max(10, n//10))
metrics_oos_pooled_diagnostic_only.topdecile_hit_secondary: P(class7 == up | top-decile), bottom-decile P(fwd7>0) for spread context
metrics_oos_pooled_diagnostic_only.calibration_in_the_large: mean P(up/down/flat) vs empirical class frequencies + bias = mean_pred - observed
metrics_oos_pooled_diagnostic_only.context_only: accuracy, log-loss, per-fold rank mean (no decisions taken on them)

go_nogo_rule_prespecified.reference: BTC best was rank 0.074 (v29 residual, overall) / hit ~49% (v29 obs P(net>0|fill) 0.48-0.49, v30 0.45). ETH must beat BTC diagnostics (stricter hit bar 55% vs 49%, rank bar 0.05 vs 0.074 best) to justify full training.
go_nogo_rule_prespecified.else: NO-GO with numbers (kills the direction cheaply). NO-GO is an acceptable honest result.
go_nogo_rule_prespecified.frozen: This rule is frozen in this config BEFORE fitting; the HGB script asserts its copy matches this file.
